goal: Build the campaign create/edit form with gap duration and max_attempts, the DRAFT default, the four explicit lifecycle transitions, terminal 409s, and the campaign table and status display.
outcome: A campaign is created in DRAFT with name, description, campaign date/time, gap duration (5-300s, default 20, presets 5/10/20/30/60) and max_attempts (1-10, default 3); only DRAFT->ACTIVE, ACTIVE->COMPLETED, ACTIVE->CANCELLED and DRAFT->CANCELLED exist and each is a conditional update so a lost race is 409; COMPLETED and CANCELLED are terminal; assignments and survey edits are allowed in DRAFT; the campaign table shows status including CANCELLED.

requirements.statement: The frame omits three REQUIRED things — gap duration control, max_attempts, and Start/Complete/Cancel. Implement all three (UX-DR17/18).
LIFECYCLE IS EXPLICIT — a new campaign is DRAFT, nothing auto-activates or auto-completes, and a DRAFT campaign must not look like a live campaign.
Server-side refusal is required even though the UI hides controls.
The form uses useState plus hand-written handlers plus fetch — no react-hook-form, no zod.
